caption: MCP Prompt
description: A prompt or prompt template that the server offers. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 Prompt; 2026-07-28 Prompt).
name: mcp_prompt

mcp_meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_prompt_argument_list.description: MCP member `arguments`: A list of arguments to use for templating the prompt.

mcp_description.description: MCP member `description`: An optional description of what this prompt provides

mcp_icon_list.description:
MCP member `icons`: Optional set of sized icons that the client can display in a user interface.

Clients that support rendering icons MUST support at least the following MIME types:
- `image/png` - PNG images (safe, universal compatibility)
- `image/jpeg` (and `image/jpg`) - JPEG images (safe, universal compatibility)

Clients that support rendering icons SHOULD also support:
- `image/svg+xml` - SVG images (scalable but requires security precautions)
- `image/webp` - WebP images (modern, efficient format)

mcp_name.description: MCP member `name` (required by the protocol): Intended for programmatic or logical use, but used as a display name in past specs or fallback (if title isn't present).

mcp_title.description:
MCP member `title`: Intended for UI and end-user contexts — optimized to be human-readable and easily understood,
even by those unfamiliar with domain-specific terminology.

If not provided, the name should be used for display (except for Tool,
where `annotations.title` should be given precedence over using `name`,
if present).

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
